recordType: observational reconciliation-window usage, not controlled experiment

codeContext.note: Coordinator-provided code context; not inferred as a source verification result.

inclusion: Owned response-level token_usage_record.usage events in inclusive timestamp window; payload.thread_id equals session_meta.id; root plus explicitly selected direct reconciliation agents and collector continuation; deduplicate response IDs per owning session. Includes retries, fixes and inspections within each selected session.
sourceHashMethod: SHA-256 of complete-line source-file byte prefix captured locally. Hash first sourcePrefixBytes bytes if live source later appends.

rootCumulativeCrossCheck.method: Final owning cumulative counter minus last pre-anchor owning counter. Compare only with root response-level sum. Intermediate cumulative counters are never summed.

limitations: Reconciliation scope includes coordination, all attempts, review, repairs, verification and collector overhead, not coding alone.
Root is a long continuing mixed chat with inherited context. Usage in this phase is observed by time boundary, not proof of perfect feature attribution or unique words.
Older unrelated direct sessions are excluded by explicit agent-path set; managed guardians and separate tool/image/system model usage are unknown, not zero.
Fixed cutoff excludes later unflushed responses, final review, PR publication and other completion overhead. This is not a full-feature invoice or complete lifecycle total.
Cached input is part of input; reasoning output is part of output. Neither is counted twice. Cache availability and inherited history confound efficiency interpretation.
Earlier snapshots remain separate and unchanged. The gap before this anchor is not measured by this snapshot; do not silently fill it or add cumulative snapshots.
No external calls, model benchmarks, controlled comparison or measured credit/currency savings.
